entries.title: Walk in God’s Peace
entries.scripture: “You will keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on you, because he trusts in you.”
entries.body: Today, pause and give your worries to God in prayer. Let His Word shape your thoughts, and choose to trust Him one step at a time.
entries.prayer: Lord, steady my heart in Your peace and help me trust You through every part of this day.
